context.canonical_title: 如何不停服地将 16 张分表迁移到 64 张？

required_checks: Verify the candidate directly covers both duplicate source rows and the explicit zero-downtime 16-table to 64-table migration scenario rather than drifting into generic sharding theory.

Verify the full-snapshot plus incremental CDC boundary: the snapshot/binlog or GTID watermark must close the copy/stream gap and recovery must tolerate connector restart/replay without silently losing writes.

Verify the cutover consistency boundary: route version/epoch or an equivalent fencing mechanism must prevent stale writers after a bucket becomes new-primary; application dual-write must not be represented as atomic.

Verify rollback semantics: once new-primary writes exist, rollback is only safe if the old side has remained current through reverse CDC/controlled dual-write or is otherwise reconciled before routing back.

Verify the scenario contract includes explicit scale inputs, a clearly hypothetical capacity calculation, idempotency/order handling, timeout/retry/compensation, observability, reconciliation, fault injection, rollout and at least one alternative/tradeoff.
Verify MySQL 8.4 online-DDL wording is version-bounded and does not imply that every DDL operation is instant or lock-free.
Verify project-experience content is only a mapping prompt/hypothetical calculation and cannot be read as fabricated personal production experience.
review_contract.promotion_boundary: Do not promote or fabricate human approval. Pilot human review remains a separate mandatory gate when required by config.

primary_sources_to_verify_independently.title: Debezium connector for MySQL
claims_to_check: the connector performs an initial consistent snapshot, records the current binlog position and streams subsequent changes from that position
connector restart can regenerate already-processed events and target processing must tolerate duplicates
if the required binlog position has been purged, continuing from the old position is impossible without re-establishing a suitable snapshot/baseline

primary_sources_to_verify_independently.title: MySQL 8.4 Introduction to InnoDB
claims_to_check: InnoDB DML follows ACID transaction semantics with commit, rollback and crash recovery

primary_sources_to_verify_independently.title: MySQL 8.4 InnoDB and Online DDL
claims_to_check: ALGORITHM and LOCK clauses control available online-DDL behavior and an operation can fail immediately when the requested concurrency level is unavailable
online DDL is operation-dependent and should not be generalized as universally lock-free

primary_sources_to_verify_independently.title: MySQL 8.4 Online DDL Operations
claims_to_check: some index and primary-key operations permit concurrent DML while other operations can rebuild/copy data or disallow the same concurrency
